{{Quote|An ingenious technique. But does the efficacy increase in direct proportion to the irregularity applied to the&mdash;?|Indigo Five asks a question|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant" />}}
A '''pilot''' flew under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[Indigo Five]] during the [[Battle of Galantos]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. After fellow [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Jagged Fel]] demonstrated a way to destroy [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yorik-et|coralskipper]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]], the pilot asked a technical question about the effectiveness of Fel's technique, until he was interrupted by a fellow member of Indigo Squadron.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic I: Remnant" />
